title: CHOKE GROUPS
author: irpina
description: Choke groups for the Digitone mk1 and Digitone Keys: a note on a track silences what the other tracks of its group are still playing, as an open hi-hat is cut by a closed one. CHOKE in the Mod Menu (hold a track key) puts the held track in group A or B, or none; saved with the project. A choked voice fades out over one block (0.7 ms). OS 1.43 and 1.44 (it names no firmware address: its 1.44 port is empty). Needs core-dn1 3.1 (its voice start and the voices' blocks), so it runs on 4.x and 5.x too.
